newsitem.title: CHINA: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mixed.
newsitem.headline: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mixed.

text.p: Following is the China Interbank Offered Rate (CHIBOR) for Wednesday issued by the official Xinhua news agency on behalf of the People's Bank of China, the central bank.
The figures represent weighted averages and not closing prices and are annual percentage rates.
Turnover fell to 4.4 billion yuan from 6.7 billion yuan on Tuesday with the seven-day contract the most active.

Despite the fall in turnover, trading was still active today with increased trading by non-bank financial institutions on rumours the central bank had convened a meeting to enforce a ban on state banks trading on the state debt secondary market.
One trader said the meeting was held yesterday afternoon in Beijing. Central bank officials declined to comment.
Traders said the bulk of the volume today came from the short-term financial centres, money brokerages run by the central bank, who mostly traded with securities houses.
Brokerages will increasingly rely on interbank trading as state banks withdraw from the state debt secondary market.
